title: Battle of Khwar Pass
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Khwar Pass", at revision 1378916206, opens: "The Battle of Khwar Pass was a failed ambush set up by Ashraf Hotaki during his retreat following his defeat at the Battle of Damghan (1729). Gathering the forces available along his route, Ashraf assembled another substantial fighting force from the remnants of his army. He also had enough troops to establish an ambush at a narrow pass east of Varamin." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q18205170, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1729 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
